systemic_note: The systemic thread is the 26.x-form residue in a genuinely adapted port: the 1.21.10 tree fixed six carried defects outright (G02, G08, G09, G16, G36, and the G21 finalize arm) and narrowed two more (G30: 29 species wrong -> 18; G15: goal-start gate fixed, hop still broken), but the remaining 36 port defects all share one cause - code or data lookups written against the 26.x form (absent tags: #entities_can_teleport_to, #blocks_motion_in_heightmap*, #causes_suffocation, #suppresses_bounce, the immune_* tags; absent classes: AbstractBedBlock, EntityTypes; absent items/components: iron_spear, mob_visibility, kinetic_weapon; 26.x-only species arms) that silently degrade in 1.21.10 because the lookups fail soft. The two majors are the sharpest instances: G14 (endermen never teleport) and G22 (the suffocation startup blocker, where the lookup fails HARD at load time). The slice also carries 9 resolved re-check items (5 fixed: G02, G08, G09, G16, G36; 4 closed: G12, G17, G42, G45) per common.md; the withdrawn 1.21.7 oracle group O02 (client.multiplayer - the package exists in 1.21.10's client jar) is recorded in the report only, since its ID is taken by the live constructor-mismatch group.
